source.title: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developers Manual Volume 2A

claim: The real-address operation pushes the FLAGS, CS and IP words before loading CS/IP from the interrupt vector. An explicitly modeled INT08 profile must therefore read its target after its modeled frame writes when those bytes alias the IVT.
read_provenance: Official PDF opened and text read on 2026-10-18. No complete PDF download or hash claim.
limits: ISA reference for a named serialized analysis profile only. Does not qualify the historical CPU, actual IRQ delivery, interrupt ownership or game runtime.
